title: Financial Services Commission (Licensing) (Amendment) Regulations, 2024
text:
Financial Services Commission
BELIZE:
FINANCIAL SERVICES COMMISSION (LICENSING)
(AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS, 2024
ARRANGEMENT OF REGULATIONS
1. Citation.
2. Amendment of regulation 2.

No. 18] Financial Services Commission 1
BELIZE:
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT
No. 18 of 2024
REGULATIONS made by the Financial Services Commission
with the approval of the Minister, in exercise of the
powers conferred upon it by sections 23(6) and 76 of
the Financial Services Commission Act, Act No. 8 of
2023, and all other powers thereunto it enabling.
(Gazetted 20th January, 2024).
1. These Regulations may be cited as the Citation.
FINANCIAL SERVICES COMMISSION
(LICENSING) (AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS,
2024,
and shall be read and construed as one with the Financial S.I. 120 of
Services Commission (Licensing) Regulations, which is 2023.
hereinafter referred to as the principal Regulations.
2. Section 2 of the principal Regulations is amended by Amendment of
regulation 2.
deleting the definition of the term “sole practitioner” and
replacing it with the following–
“means–
(a) a person licensed by the Commission to
conduct the business of a registered agent
who does not, in the normal course of
doing so, act in association with any other
person to conduct business; or
(b) a firm of not more than three attorneys or
accountants;”.

2 Financial Services Commission [No. 18
MADE by the Financial Services Commission this 17th day
of January, 2024.
JOSEPH WAIGHT
Chairman
Financial Services Commission
APPROVED by the Minister responsible for financial services
this 17th day of January, 2024.
HON. JOHN BRICEÑO
Prime Minister
(Minister responsible for Financial Services)
